plate.narration: Rain sweeps across a temple island high above the realm. Wind banners stream over the wet landing. Through the clouds, another island appears for a moment, then fades behind the rain.

goal.text: Keep the temple safe as the returning island drifts toward it.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

arrival.narration: The island you helped welcome home is drifting toward a temple island through heavy rain. A different kitsune keeper from the one at the lookout rings a bell. Its rope wears a tiny raincoat. Beside the temple, a fresh opening spills bone crawlers onto the wet landing: little scuttling creatures with rattling backs. "Help us keep the temple safe as that island drifts in!" the keeper calls. "First, get everyone under cover."

variants.text: Your warning reached this bell tower in time. The keepers have already moved the heavy furniture inside.
Your course warning has not reached them yet. Their furniture still waits in the yard.

look.narration: From behind the fence, watch the island's edge creep past the bell tower. Mark it between gusts.

interaction.cue: Mark the edge when the rain clears.

onFailure.narration: Rain hides the edge. The keeper checks it herself.

people.narration: Keepers are still hauling cushions across the yard. "Everyone needs a dry lane into the hall," says the keeper. "Let's see what still blocks the door."

screen.narration: A folded screen flaps in the doorway like a sail. "It wants to come in first," says the keeper. Carry it flat, or tie it and pass it along the fence?

variants.text: Your warning got the heavy screen inside. Only a cushion bundle is left, and the top cushion is trying to be a hat. Carry it flat, or tie it and pass it along?

people_check.narration: Keep the screen level while the keeper guides it through the door. Its painted birds go in beak first.

variants.text: Keep the cushion bundle level while the keeper guides it through the door.

screen_relay.narration: Pass the tied screen hand to hand along the fence.

interaction.cue: Pass the bundle into the hall.

variants.text: Pass the cushion bundle hand to hand along the fence.

ready_lane.narration: One last keeper is still hugging a cushion in the rain. "Nobody stays outside to rescue a cushion," says the temple keeper. How do you help?

messages.narration: The last keeper reaches the covered hall. "Shelter for everyone," says the temple keeper, "even the bell rope's spare raincoat." The temple's own griffin messenger rests at the back. When the wind clears, it can fly travelers down to the mountain pass called the Cairnstep.

variants.text: The island letter courier, whose sealed letters you saved, offers to relay your signals from the hall.
The island letter courier is still finishing the delayed letter relay. A keeper minds the signals for now.

gear.narration: There are two jobs and time for one. Rig the long turning rope, so pushing the island away goes faster. Or fasten wind cover, so the gusts cannot knock you about. Neither stops the crawlers.

gear_rope.narration: Guide the long rope loop over the turning post. Somebody's socks flap on a line right beside it. Do not catch the socks.

interaction.cue: Drop the loop over the post.

onSuccess.narration: The long rope is ready. A push will go faster.

onFailure.narration: The loop snags the socks! Rig the shorter store rope instead.

onAssisted.narration: With the keeper's help, the long rope is ready.

short_line.narration: Pass the shorter store rope to the nearer post. The socks are not invited.

interaction.cue: Pass the shorter line to the nearer post.

onSuccess.narration: The short rope is tied on.

onFailure.narration: The short rope is tied on.

onAssisted.narration: The short rope is tied on.

shelter_check.narration: Hold the wind cover low while the keeper ties it down. It keeps off gusts, not crawlers.

interaction.cue: Hold the cover while it is tied.

shelter_braced.narration: Your thornguard uses a skill called Brace and holds the wind cover steady while the keeper ties it down. It barely flaps. Everyone else keeps an eye on the island.

signals.narration: The keeper raises a cloth for hold and lowers it for release. "Watch once," she says. "Shouts get lost in a squall."

interaction.cue: Watch the cloth, then copy it.

onFailure.narration: The keeper will lead the calls herself.

onAssisted.narration: The keeper will lead the calls herself.

rest.narration: "Rice buns for everyone!" the keeper calls, passing a basket around the hall. You rest on rescued cushions. One has an embroidered bird with a bun crumb on its beak.

plan.narration: The island's low edge slides up beside the mooring posts. "Now we choose," says the keeper. "Turn it away, or hold the landing and let it settle here."

push_plan.narration: You run the strong ropes through the mooring posts, loose enough to slip free after. The keeper holds the release cloth ready. "A small turn," she says. "Not a tug across the sky."

fight_push.narration: Bone crawlers rattle up the landing! Hold the turning post for three turns to swing the island clear, or chase the crawlers off. Gusts knock everyone about, and the crosswind shoves you west.

fight_push_rope.narration: Bone crawlers rattle up the landing! With the long rope, two turns at the post will swing the island clear. Or chase the crawlers off. Gusts knock everyone about, and the crosswind shoves you west.

fight_push_cover.narration: Bone crawlers rattle up the landing! Hold the turning post for three turns to swing the island clear, or chase the crawlers off. Your cover keeps the gusts off you, not them. The crosswind still shoves you west.

shelter_plan.narration: You pull the sheltered corner tight and leave room for the island's edge to rest. The keeper chalks a line the temple cushions must never cross, even after the storm.

fight_shelter.narration: Bone crawlers rattle up the landing! Hold the sheltered corner for two rounds while the island settles, or chase the crawlers off. Gusts knock everyone about, and the crosswind shoves you west.

fight_shelter_rope.narration: Bone crawlers rattle up the landing! Hold the sheltered corner for two rounds while the island settles, or chase the crawlers off. Gusts knock everyone about, and the crosswind shoves you west.

fight_shelter_cover.narration: Bone crawlers rattle up the landing! Hold the sheltered corner for two rounds while the island settles, or chase the crawlers off. Your cover keeps the gusts off you, not them. The crosswind still shoves you west.

pushed.narration: The island's low edge turns past the posts. The keepers let the rope go, and the island drifts clear, trailing rain from its grass. The keeper sits straight down on a cushion.

settled.narration: The island's low edge settles beside the landing. Your cover holds. The keepers close the outer gate to mark where the temple ends. Someone hangs a polite sign on it: PLEASE KNOCK, EVEN IF YOU ARE AN ISLAND.

damaged.narration: The crawlers drive everyone back behind the gate. The island bumps the empty landing. Boards crack and the awning folds, but everyone is safe under the stone roof. The landing must stay closed tonight. The morning crew will need your spare boards to fix it.

boards_check.narration: From the stone doorstep, look along the near boards. "Rain hides loose edges," the keeper warns.

interaction.cue: Mark the board edge when the rain clears.

onSuccess.narration: The keeper chalks the boards you checked.

onFailure.narration: The keeper closes the outer boards to be safe.

onAssisted.narration: The keeper checks them with you, board by board.

roof.narration: "Drips are finding every dry cushion," the keeper sighs. Leaves plug the gutter. Poke them clear with the long pole, or set a basin under the loose gutter end?

roof_pole.narration: From the dry side, guide the pole to the leaf wad. A good plop is all the applause you need.

interaction.cue: Guide the pole tip to the leaves.

onSuccess.narration: Plop! The water runs away from the door.

onFailure.narration: Splash! Water spills onto the doorstep. Grab a broom.

onAssisted.narration: Plop! The water runs away from the door.

roof_basin.narration: Set the basin level under the gutter while the keeper holds it from the window.

runoff_help.narration: Pass the broom and doormat to the keeper and sweep the puddle out.

interaction.cue: Pass the broom and mat along.

repair.narration: The keeper taps her logbook. "The next crew needs to know what we leave them," she says. Leave your spare boards and line, or pack them back up?

variants.text: The outer landing is broken and stays closed tonight. The morning crew needs your spare boards and line to fix it.

repair_1.narration: Hand the spare boards and line to the keeper. One board tries to fly off like a kite.

interaction.cue: Pass the kit into the store.

onSuccess.narration: The kit stays with the temple.

onFailure.narration: The kit stays with the temple.

onAssisted.narration: The kit stays with the temple.

repair_2.narration: Hold the spare kit while the keeper unties it. Take back what you never used.

onSuccess.narration: The kit goes back in your packs.

onFailure.narration: The kit goes back in your packs.

onAssisted.narration: The kit goes back in your packs.

record.narration: The keeper opens her logbook beside the old island songs and slides it away from a raindrop. "Tomorrow's watch needs the truth," she says. Write down the cloth signals, or draw a map of the safe edge?

record_signals.narration: You and the keeper write down the night: the ropes, the fight and where the island is now. Rain ticks on the window.

variants.text: The log says you copied the first cloth calls yourselves.
The log says the keeper led the first cloth calls.

record_map.narration: Trace the edge you checked. Leave the unchecked boards blank.

interaction.cue: Mark only the edge you checked.

onSuccess.narration: The map shows which boards are safe.

onFailure.narration: The keeper marks only the safe doorstep.

onAssisted.narration: The map shows which boards are safe.

watch.narration: The relief watch arrives, shaking rain off their tails. Any watch can use a fixed lookout spot. If you wrote down the signals, you can teach the cloth drill instead. Which will you show them?

watch_signals.narration: The keeper shows the calls: hold, hold, release, hold. Copy them for the relief watch.

onSuccess.narration: The relief watch learns your calls.

onFailure.narration: The keeper will show them herself.

onAssisted.narration: The keeper will show them herself.

watch_help.narration: Help the keeper show the hold and release calls. The relief watch copies her cloth with a slack practice rope.

watch_map.narration: Line up the fence post with the tower's edge to make a lookout spot.

interaction.cue: Mark the edge when the rain clears.

onSuccess.narration: The relief watch can see the edge from safe ground.

onFailure.narration: Rain hides the edge. Set a lookout at the doorstep instead.

onAssisted.narration: The relief watch can see the edge from safe ground.

watch_map_help.narration: Pass a bright marker to the keeper at the stone doorstep.

interaction.cue: Pass the marker to the keeper.

ending.narration: The temple is safe, and every keeper is dry. As the squall eases, the fresh opening shrinks shut, and no more crawlers can get in. The bell rope drops its tiny raincoat into a bucket. Soon the griffin messenger can fly you down to the Cairnstep, or you can go back to the island lookout.

variants.text: The landing stays closed for repairs, but everyone is safe.
The returned island now rests beside the temple, with a brand-new edge to watch.
Your spare boards and line stay with the morning crew.
Your unused kit rides along in your packs.
The outer boards still need checking.

finish.narration: The keeper shuts the log fast. "Before the pages drink any more rain!" You can rest here, go back to the lookout, or fly with the griffin messenger down to the Cairnstep.

ready_lane_response_door.narration: The last keeper reaches the hall. Everyone is under the stone roof.

ready_lane_response_count.narration: The keeper confirms nobody is left outside. Everyone is under the stone roof.

ready_lane_response_cushion.narration: A cushion retires from duty as a very soft helmet. Everyone is under the stone roof.

watch_help_response_hold.narration: Nobody loads the line during the drill. The relief watch knows the calls now.

watch_help_response_cloth.narration: The relief watch follows the keeper. Soon they know every call.

watch_help_response_account.narration: The log credits the keeper-led demonstration. The relief watch knows the calls now.
